title: Trademark license

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Separate permission from execution so a partner understands that knowing the artwork rules does not itself grant usage rights.
strategic_value: Clear licensing and attribution instructions can help preserve IBM’s ownership while enabling permitted collaboration.
demonstration: The main text explains trademark licensing and attribution; a separate right-hand column gives the attribution statement.
practical_value: Confirm the applicable license and determine whether the stated attribution exception applies to the intended format.

content_islands.name: License guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the title at left and licensing paragraphs in the center column.

content_islands.name: Attribution specimen
content_islands.spec: Separate the sample attribution statement at right with a thin vertical rule.

reference_purposes.Application: The page directs partners to establish the appropriate agreement and supplies a trademark-attribution format.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Other than fair use, trademark use requires a license. Attribution may be omitted in limited-space cases or where it would impair the message, as the source qualifies.
